what: Data Management Foundation for Hedgerow Trading System
title: Data Management Foundation for Hedgerow Trading System
text: HedgeRoot data management foundation Hedgerow trading system. provides robust, production-ready data infrastructure package handles high-performance data fetching, validation, storage, management capabilities financial data.

title: Data Management Foundation for Hedgerow Trading System
text: Multi-Source Data Integration: Support Alpha Vantage, Interactive Brokers, Yahoo Finance Advanced Provider Management: Intelligent failover circuit breakers health monitoring High-Performance Architecture: Leverages data.table optimal performance Comprehensive Data Validation: Built-quality control anomaly detection S7 Object System: Modern, type-safe data structures

title: Data Management Foundation for Hedgerow Trading System
text: can install development version hedgeroot GitHub:

title: Data Management Foundation for Hedgerow Trading System
code: library(hedgeroot)  # Create a provider provider <- create_alpha_vantage_provider(api_key = "your_api_key")  # Fetch OHLCV data data <- fetch_ohlcv(provider, "AAPL", "2023-01-01", "2023-12-31")

title: Data Management Foundation for Hedgerow Trading System
code: # Create multiple providers with failover providers <- list(   create_alpha_vantage_provider(api_key = "your_av_key"),   create_ib_provider(host = "127.0.0.1", port = 7497) )  # Create advanced manager with circuit breaker manager <- create_advanced_provider_manager(   providers = providers,   failover_strategy = "priority",   circuit_breaker_threshold = 3,   circuit_breaker_window = 15 )  # Fetch data with automatic failover data <- fetch_ohlcv(manager, "AAPL", "2023-01-01", "2023-12-31")

title: Data Management Foundation for Hedgerow Trading System
code: # Validate fetched data validation <- validate_data(data)  # Check validation results if (validation@is_valid) {   cat("Data quality score:", validation@quality_score, "\n") } else {   cat("Validation errors:", validation@errors, "\n") }
